hero_eyebrow: Free to start · Runs in your browser · Nothing is uploaded
hero_lead: Draw shapes, lines, freehand paths and text, then export as SVG or PNG. Everything is processed locally — nothing is ever sent to a server.
footnote: Your drawing stays in this browser tab — nothing is uploaded or saved automatically.
how_lead: Pick a tool, draw on the canvas, adjust colors and stroke, then export.
step1_desc: Rectangle, ellipse, line, freehand pen, or text.
step2_desc: Drag on the canvas, then adjust fill, stroke, and size in the panel.
step3_desc: Download as a scalable SVG file or a flattened PNG image.
